name: Get transformer
description: Get transformer Gets a single custom log transformer by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logpush/transformers/{transformer_id}

name: Get transformer content
description: Get transformer content Returns the SQL query content for a transformer. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logpush/transformers/{transformer_id}/content
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logpush/transformers/{transformer_id}/content
Returns the SQL query content for a transformer. Without query params, returns the latest version. With `version_id`, returns the specified version.
Required: account_id (path); transformer_id (path)
Optional: version_id (query) — Specific version ID to retrieve. When omitted, the latest version is returned.

name: List transformer versions
description: List transformer versions Returns version metadata for a transformer, newest first. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logpush/transformers/{transformer_id}/versions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logpush/transformers/{transformer_id}/versions
Returns version metadata for a transformer, newest first. Each version corresponds to a SQL query update.
Required: account_id (path); transformer_id (path)
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of versions to return.
